intended_object: The canonical comparison map, used inside the Henkin construction ported from Flypitch, from the colimit carrier of the chain of bounded formulas (with one free variable) over the Henkin language tower to bounded formulas over the limit language L_∞. It is inferred from the docstring, the name and how it is used in the bijectivity/equivalence lemmas.
explanation: This is a specialization of `boundedFormulaComparison` (defined at line 676) to n = 1, l = 0. It sets up the canonical map from the colimit of formulas to formulas over the colimit language. Later the file proves this map is bijective (line 1053) and builds an `Equiv` from it (line 1061), which the Henkin-witness construction in the completeness proof needs. It is proof plumbing for one particular step of the Flypitch completeness proof: a map between two specific constructions, not a standard mathematical notion with its own place in the literature. So `not_a_mathematical_object` is the right verdict, and the questions of faithfulness or generality do not apply.
